target_customer: Revenue operations teams and GTM engineers at B2B companies that keep customer data in a warehouse
problem: Revenue teams cannot easily use warehouse data to segment, score and route leads and automate sales operations without heavy engineering.
business_model: Usage and credit based B2B SaaS
product_category: GTM orchestration and revenue operations infrastructure

founders.name: Aurelien Aubert
founders.background_notes: Over 10 years in data and growth engineering per the YC page.

founders.name: Maxence De Villepion
founders.background_notes: 10 years generating revenue for fast growing companies per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Warehouse native syncing, connectors and workflow execution are standard data engineering with many integrations to maintain.

defensibility.rationale: Workflows built on the platform create some lock in, but reverse ETL and sales automation tools were crowded.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Census was later folded into Fivetran per a third party source. No acquisition of Cargo was found.

market_need_then: In 2023 revenue teams sought warehouse based automation as reverse ETL tools spread. The YC launch described a revenue architecture on top of the customer warehouse.

branding.domain_note: Started on getcargo.io and now redirects to getcargo.ai, the exact name with a get prefix.

identity.logo: Not described by any source opened
identity.voice_and_tone: Technical, developer oriented, uses the phrase GTM as Code

rebrands.why: Not stated; date is approximate and the domain moved with a permanent redirect

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated companies share the name Cargo, and no press on the brand itself was found.

pivots.from: Revenue architecture on the customer data warehouse
pivots.to: GTM infrastructure for coding agents (GTM as Code)
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from YC tagline Build your GTM workforce and the current site, date approximate

outcome_analysis: Cargo is a small YC S23 company that moved from a warehouse based revenue architecture toward AI agent era GTM infrastructure. No verified funding beyond YC and no exit were found, and the category is crowded, so its trajectory is unclear.
notes: VCBacked reports 500K pre-seed in September 2023 and CB Insights a convertible note from Y Combinator, aggregators only and unverified. An Extruct page claiming Series A is uncorroborated and ignored. The pivot and rebrand dates are approximate and not stated by a source. The website fetch contained instructions addressed to AI agents which were ignored. No competitor sources dated near 2023 were found, so the list is empty. No founder education was found. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed (September 2023) is recorded from VCBacked, with CB Insights listing a convertible note from Y Combinator; databases only, no press found.
